add.notes_fr: Colonie d'Afro-Américains libres fondée par la Maryland State Colonization Society, devenue république en 1854 puis rattachée au Liberia en 1857.
add.notes_en: A settlement of free African Americans founded by the Maryland State Colonization Society, which became a republic in 1854 and joined Liberia in 1857.
